svg.title: Comfort Index by question group and model
svg.desc: Heatmap of the Comfort Index (0-100) for each group of questions and each model; darker is more comfortable. Each cell links to that model's answers to the questions in the group.
svg.text: Cell = group mean; colour key below (50-90). Groups with no evaluative question are omitted.
